correctness.rationale: A Prüfer deletion bijection and exact occupancy moments give all mixed/individual moments. Separate diagonal and disjoint cherry pairs yield the second moment. Exponential inequalities prove strict positivity for all n>=5. The variance expansion is positive definite, and the published bounded-perturbation Gaussian criterion applied by Cramér–Wold gives the joint limit. Independent enumeration and the packaged standard-library checker agree across 282379 exact and diagnostic checks; finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: Degree-three cherry counts quantify local tree automorphisms, and leaf count is a canonical global tree-shape statistic. The exact strict positive covariance at every n>=5 and its explicit nonzero Gaussian-limit correlation reveal dependence invisible to degree-one/degree-three marginal asymptotic independence. A full natural all-order invariant and 2D fluctuation classification, rather than a small enumerative slice.
